summary: Iteration 25 verification of 7 bug fixes on TaskMint. Results: (1) Withdraw Offerwall amount input PASS — matches UPI input styling (fontSize 15px vs 15px, same border 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), same borderRadius 20px, same white bg, same 14px padding; visible 21px gap between UPI/Bank tabs and Enter Points box). (2) Splash screen PASS — expo-splash-screen imported, SplashScreen.preventAutoHideAsync() at module load (line 19) and SplashScreen.hideAsync() inside SplashGate component when !loading (line 107) in _layout.tsx. (3) Home tab task cards PASS — both campaignName (line 279) and campaignNote (line 288) have numberOfLines={1}, ellipsizeMode='tail', adjustsFontSizeToFit, minimumFontScale={0.85}; campaign style has marginBottom: 6 (line 427). (4) Wallet transactions PASS — txn style has marginBottom: 6 (line 197). (5a) Banners optional title/subtitle PASS — POST /api/admin/banners with empty title/subtitle returned 200, banner visible in GET /api/banners with empty title, delete cleanup 200; frontend BannerCreate model has Optional[str] = '' and placeholder texts say '(optional)'. (5b) Campaign pin PASS — POST creates campaign, PUT with pinned=true returns 200, GET /api/campaigns returns pinned campaign before all unpinned ones; home.tsx sort function has `const pa = (a as any).pinned ? 0 : 1;` at line 242 (executed before status rank). (5c) Game rewards config PASS — GET /api/admin/app-config returns all 19 expected keys (spin_min/max, scratch_min/max, visit_min/max, watch_min/max, survey_min/max, quiz_min/max, checkin_base/step/cap, daily_challenge_common=50, uncommon=150, rare=300, jackpot=1000); PUT with daily_challenge_jackpot=2000 persists, then restored; frontend game-rewards.tsx contains all 14 game sections (Daily Check-in, Spin & Win, Scratch & Earn, Visit & Earn, Watch & Earn, Surveys, Quizzes, Higher or Lower, Memory Match, Tic-Tac-Toe, Math Sprint, Tap-the-Coin Rush, Trivia Streak, Daily Challenge (Mystery Box)). All 4 pytest tests PASSED (0 failures).
critical_code_review_comments: withdraw.tsx: amount input wrapper (amountInputBox) and standalone input share identical border/radius/background — visual parity confirmed via computed style.
_layout.tsx: SplashGate is a small component correctly reading useAuth() and calling hideAsync when loading resolves; safe pattern.
server.py BannerCreate: title/subtitle are Optional[str] = '' (not None) — matches frontend contract that sends empty strings by default.

PUT /api/admin/campaigns/{id} requires full Campaign body (returns 422 on partial update). This is not a fix regression, just an API design choice; frontend admin UI already sends full body when toggling pinned.
